{"reason": "Failure rows show two demand-forecast-error patterns v1 labels unknown: market-mismatch=#t with zero bias (5 rows, ~854k) and forecast-bias with small bias 0.065-0.081 below the 0.1 cutoff (3 rows, ~476k). I added a market-signal-mismatch branch before else and lowered the bias threshold to 0.06; supplier-delay keeps precedence.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
